criteria.requirement: Create a `Group` named `picking-fixture` containing three logical pick groups
criteria.action: Open fixture mode and inspect the live scene graph, mesh geometry parameters, world transforms, and active camera.
criteria.expected: All three named groups and child meshes exist with the specified dimensions and positions; the camera has the specified projection and pose. (Tolerance: Positions and dimensions within 1e-6; camera projection values within 1e-6.)

criteria.action: Call window.pickingProbe.pick(0,0) after the fixture and camera matrices are updated.
criteria.expected: The result identifies front and front-surface, point [0,0,1.5], distance 10.5, and selectedObjects contains only front-surface. (Tolerance: Point and distance absolute error at most 1e-5.)

criteria.requirement: On a valid miss, return null, clear both selections, and leave `lastError` null.
criteria.action: Call pick(0.08,0), then pick(0.8,0), inspecting returned values and live selection after each call.
criteria.expected: The first ray passes beside front and hits rear at approximately [0.8005923733,0,-1] with distance approximately 13.0246284; the second returns null and clears selection without an error. (Tolerance: Rear point and distance absolute error at most 1e-5.)

criteria.requirement: `project(id)` must return the logical group's world position transformed by Three.js `Vector3.project(currentCamera)`
criteria.action: Call project('offset') with the initial camera, then orbit the camera and call it again.
criteria.expected: Initially x is approximately 0.3247595264 and y is 0; after orbiting, the result equals a fresh Vector3 projection using the current camera. (Tolerance: Each compared component within 1e-6.)

criteria.requirement: Invalid input returns null, sets `lastError` to `invalid-ndc`, and leaves selection and `pickCount` unchanged.
criteria.action: Establish a hit, record state, and call pick with NaN, Infinity, 1.01, and a nonnumeric value.
criteria.expected: Every call returns null and reports invalid-ndc while selectedObjects, selectedId, and pickCount remain unchanged. (Tolerance: Exact state equality.)

criteria.requirement: Primary-button canvas pointer picks must use the same picking routine
criteria.action: Dispatch a primary-button pointer event at the canvas rectangle center and another outside the rectangle.
criteria.expected: The center event selects front and increments pickCount once; the outside event changes neither selection nor diagnostics. (Tolerance: Exact ID and counter equality.)

criteria.requirement: `reset()` clears selection and `lastError`, sets `pickCount` to zero, and restores the initial camera pose and orbit target
criteria.action: Disable selection and attempt a pick, re-enable it, make picks and move the camera, then invoke reset.
criteria.expected: The disabled pick changes nothing; reset produces selectedId null, lastError null, pickCount 0, empty selectedObjects, and the initial camera and target. (Tolerance: Camera and target components within 1e-6; diagnostic state exact.)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
